rules: A composite path is evidence only for the listed call path and cases; it does not independently prove each member routine.
Expression or instruction-window evidence is not whole-function evidence.
Compile-only, layout, and source-string checks are not semantic differentials.
Replay/frame goldens are end-to-end observations and do not attribute correctness to individual routines.
Keep the immutable locked image, source hypotheses, tooling limitations, and acceptance requirements distinct.
